normalized.description: VITO is seeking to acquire a high-performance X-ray Computed Tomography (CT) system to enable non-destructive internal imaging across research& development activities on battery diagnostic, and quality control applications. The system must provide micro-level spatial resolution, flexible scanning geometries, and support for a wide range of sample sizes and material densities. To ensure versatility across different imaging scenarios, configurations with multiple X-ray sources (e.g. combining high-resolution and higher-power imaging capabilities) are preferred. The solution must include reconstruction software, calibration tools, installation, and training.
